user: Can you explain what RAM is, briefly?
assistant: Sure! RAM is your computer's short-term memory. It holds the apps and data you're using right now so the processor can reach them quickly. More RAM lets you run more things at once without slowdowns. It's cleared when the PC turns off, unlike your disk, which keeps files permanently.
